projects.title: Biometric Fingerprint
projects.description: Designed a algorithm in Matlab using image processing methods to find identifying characteristics of a individual's fingerprint.  These characteristics were then used to identify a individual out of a moderate sized population. This was done using FFTs and k-nearest neighbor algorithm.

projects.title: Flexible wireless bio-sensor
projects.description: Lead a team to design and build a wearable biomedical sensor array with wireless communications. This sensor array is able to monitor a number of different vital signs. My contributions to this project were; keeping the project on budget and on schedule, design and manufacture of the device, and the user interface. This project taught principles associated with all phases of product development, from the initial idea and subsequent design phases to extensive testing and then production.
